title: Baked Chicken Enchiladas Verdes
description: Shredded chicken rolled in corn tortillas with a tangy green salsa and melted cheese.
steps: Warm the tortillas, then fill with chicken and roll up, placing seam-side down in a baking dish.
Pour the salsa verde over the top and scatter with cheese.
Bake at 190C for 20 minutes until bubbling, then top with sour cream and cilantro.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food Mexican recipe collection

notes: Warming the tortillas first stops them cracking when you roll them.
